frozen.question: Do iPhone 11 owners report smooth operation, slowdowns, or freezing?

chunks.text: Good phone. Great value, screen sometimes doesn’t want to operate like it freezes up sometimes and I have to close out of the app I was in or sometimes it’s slow a little but I can live with it. Everything is in perfect working order and screen is in great condition came with a screen protector. Awesome phone, wish the battery life was a little longer though, last maybe two-three hours using it. Checking my phone and going on every now and then last about ten hours, so not too bad.
Smh. It moves very slow , some times my screen freezes I have to turn the phone off then back on again.
It’s okay sometimes it freezes. Sometimes it freezes but It might be because I try to move at the speed of light haha

Freezes often. My girlfriend bought this as a t mobile locked phone and we can’t get past the language selection screen. We’ve tried turning it off and restarting the device but it simply won’t work. I’ll need a replacement because I just can’t use it. It freezes no matter what language we pick. Unprofessional

Beware of certain sellers. ( 62 days old) bright light on bottom pages disappears, phone freezes, s amazon told seller to send another one. Been waiting 3 months seller keeps on refusing. Amazon promised me that they will talk to him and I will get another one. Called 4 times since April. I would never buy from this seller again. Only amazon direct where they have control Also the phone gets very very hot and can not hold a charge for long time battery wears down fast

The owner won’t help if there’s a problem they caused!. After maybe a month or 2 of having my phone it started turning on and off by itself all the time and then I looked it up and then found out it was because my screen had risen. Now keep in mind I had not taken my phone out of its case for the entire time of having it! The cause of this problem was that they didn’t properly install the screen back on. I then texted the owner and I was asking for them to fix it because it’s not my problem, it’s there’s. The owner will not take my phone back to fix the damages they have caused. Sorry if your phone messed up, THEY DO NOT CARE!
No problem so far. The activation was smooth with no problems. This is a great buy.
It okey. It alright it freezes from time to time and cut you in and out of calls

Annoyance. I’ve had this phone for 3months and it has started to glitch and freeze. Buy the warranty package. I purchased another phone with the warranty protection package and I forgot to add the warranty to this phone as well. sad the phone works well enough just a minor annoyance.
It keeps freezing.. This phone keeps freezing on me. I’m going to give it another day or so. If it keeps happening I’m going to return it. Not satisfied at all at this point

sentences.text: One iPhone 11 owner said the screen sometimes freezes and they have to close out of the app, and that it is sometimes a little slow but they can live with it.
Another owner reported that the phone moves very slowly and that the screen sometimes freezes, requiring a restart.
A reviewer said the phone is okay but sometimes freezes, possibly because they try to move at the speed of light.
One owner reported the phone freezes often and would not get past the language selection screen, requiring a replacement.
A reviewer reported the phone freezes and also gets very hot and cannot hold a charge for long.
In contrast, one owner reported no problem so far and that activation was smooth.
